reasoning_content:
Keycloak is still starting (health: starting). Wait for it. The auth.localhost route for keycloak is on websecure entrypoint originally, but I passed TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT=web. Let me wait and re-test.

Actually the previous 404 may be because keycloak isn't ready. pgadmin returns 302 (redirect to login) which is good. Let me wait for keycloak.

action.command: sleep 30; cd /workspace && docker inspect workspace-keycloak-1 --format '{{.State.Health.Status}}'; for h in auth.localhost valhalla.localhost streamlet.localhost; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$h -> %{http_code}\n" -H "Host: $h" http://localhost:3000/ --max-time 10; done; echo "--- keycloak realm ---"; curl -s -H "Host: auth.localhost" http://localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution --max-time 10 | head -c 200
